methodology.input_generation: sympy.nextprime deterministic seeds; factors withheld from program invocations
methodology.timing_scope: C++ kernel: candidate construction, full smoothness trial division, rank/dependencies and up to 64 dependency extraction attempts; prime list and Engine allocation outside kernel timing
methodology.factorization_criteria: only independently checked nontrivial gcd of valid square congruence is a factor; raw smooth residual is NOT a valid relation
methodology.comparator: QS x^2-N smooth values; NearPlus/NearMinus compare direct residual enumeration; NOT a full CADO-NFS/GNFS comparison
methodology.geometry_assumption: all selected semiprimes satisfy p<q<2p; only GroupingBand uses this to restrict group range
methodology.note: SquareY uses uniformly spaced Y in [0,3N/4]; CTM and QS start at ceil(sqrt N); these policies are not matched factor-geography priors
